usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve geographic or datacenter location metadata for resources across all remotes, or scoped to a named view. No special privileges are required — any authenticated user can call it. If a remote is temporarily unreachable, PDM will fall back to cached data up to `max-age` seconds old (default 86400 = 24 hours), so results may be stale for offline remotes.

examples.summary: Get location info scoped to a specific view, with a 1-hour cache tolerance

tips: Omitting `view` returns location info across all remotes known to PDM — useful for a global inventory sweep.
Set `max-age=0` to force a live fetch from all remotes instead of accepting any cached data; expect higher latency.
Cached data is always returned when a remote is unreachable, regardless of `max-age` — the param only controls staleness tolerance for reachable remotes.
